title: From Software Requirements Specifications to Agile User Stories Using Large Language Models: A Critical Literature Review and Proposed Evaluation Framework
description: Supporting research materials for a critical literature review by two researchers (Zaher Fadhil Raham and Sura Salah), who selected and appraised sources through joint discussion and agreement without independent screening or an inter-rater agreement statistic. The proposed source-grounded evaluation framework has not been empirically validated. The descriptive bibliographic collection contains 207 imported entries, 26 duplicates and 181 unique candidates, not 181 included studies. Rights and provenance should be verified before public release.
